atomicity.reason: One obligation - a single published power characteristic over one temperature interval.

comprehensibility.reason: The intent and the characteristic are intelligible from the requirement alone.

feasibility.reason: A linear interpolation on an already-acquired temperature; consistent with REQ_CELL_OVERTEMPERATURE, since permitted power reaches zero exactly where the contactors open.

parent_fit.reason: Delivers the parent story's observable that on a hot day the pack keeps delivering drive power at a reduced but predictable level instead of cutting out.

unambiguity.reason: Behaviour outside the interval is not stated, so it is open whether the published power is unconstrained below 55 C and whether it stays at zero above 60 C; 'full permitted value' is also an undefined term.
unambiguity.suggestion: State the values outside the band explicitly (unrestricted below 55 C, zero at and above 60 C) and define the full permitted value.

verifiability.reason: The band endpoints (55 C, 60 C) and the shape (linear to zero) are given, but 'the full permitted value' is never quantified and no tolerance is stated for how closely the published power must follow the line, so a pass/fail measurement cannot be constructed.
verifiability.suggestion: Name or quantify the value that 'full permitted value' refers to, and state the allowed deviation from the ideal characteristic (e.g. within 2 % of the full value at any temperature in the band).

summary: Right idea and the correct anchor points, but 'the full permitted value' is never quantified, no tolerance is given for the linear characteristic, and behaviour outside the 55-60 C band is unstated.
